instructions: 0019 LOADK      R3 K14='SeasonServer:SetSeasonChangeInfo info is nil!'

experience_semantics: Experience is the cost from this level to the next. The terminal zero identifies the maximum. SeasonChangeInfo.exp and profile exp hold experience within the current level; total_exp and old_total_exp are separate cumulative fields.
local_policy: Only action progression uses this curve; account, blast and fishing levels remain independent.
A pre-existing saved action level with no action XP ledger starts an audited local baseline at that level floor only when a real reward is granted. This baseline is not earned XP.
Newly tracked earned XP is separate from the existing players.xp receipt ledger.
The caller owns the reward transaction and emits notifications only after commit.
limitations: Original remote account initialization and experience reward evaluator are unavailable.
The package header is encrypted. Binding uses complete native reflected field order and types, the unique complete serialized match, the native config name and original Lua consumers.
The action curve does not prove a simultaneous account experience grant.
The maximum level stops level advancement; this local ledger retains awarded XP without inventing an unsupported discard or experience cap.
